items.example: I think I'm coming down with the flu.
items.simple: You start to get an illness, like a cold.

items.example: He always gets away with everything.
items.exampleTr: Her şey hep yanına kâr kalıyor.
items.simple: You do something bad and nobody catches you.

items.example: Her red coat really stands out.
items.simple: You are easy to see because you are not like the others.

items.example: We wound up eating pizza at midnight.
items.exampleTr: Sonunda gece yarısı pizza yerken bulduk kendimizi.
items.simple: After some things happen, you are in a place you did not plan.

items.example: I can get by with a little money.
items.simple: You have just enough to live, not more.

items.example: She's been going through a lot lately.
items.simple: You live through something hard or sad.

items.example: I totally messed up the interview.
items.simple: You do something wrong and it goes badly.

items.example: I can't believe we pulled it off!
items.simple: You do something hard and it works, even if it looked impossible.

items.example: They carried out a survey last week.
items.simple: You do a job or a plan that was already agreed.

items.example: The whole plan fell apart.
items.simple: Something breaks into many pieces, or stops working at all.

items.example: In the end, I gave in and said yes.
items.simple: You stop saying no, and let the other person win.

items.example: I had to hold back my tears.
items.simple: You do not let yourself do or show something.

items.example: He always plays down his success.
items.simple: You say something is smaller or less important than it is.

items.example: We can't rule out bad weather.
items.simple: You say that something cannot happen or cannot be the answer.

items.example: I had to settle for second place.
items.simple: You take something that is not what you wanted, because it is okay.

items.example: Let's stick to the plan.
items.simple: You keep doing what you said and do not change.

items.example: The small chat turned into a fight.
items.simple: One thing slowly becomes a different thing.

items.example: I'll make up for it by cooking dinner.
items.simple: You do something good to fix something bad you did.

items.example: The film didn't live up to the hype.
items.simple: You are as good as people hoped you would be.

items.example: He dropped out of university after a year.
items.simple: You stop going to school before you finish.

items.example: The teacher told him off for being late.
items.exampleTr: Öğretmen geç kaldığı için ona fırça attı.
items.simple: You speak in a cross voice to someone who did something wrong.

items.example: Nobody owned up to breaking the window.
items.exampleTr: Hiç kimse camı kırdığını itiraf etmedi.
items.simple: You say 'it was me' about something bad you did.

items.example: Our holiday plans fell through.
items.simple: A plan does not happen, even though you wanted it to.
